title: Not what I expected.
text: Not what I expected.. Only came with 3 bags instead of 4. Material is cheap for the price. And the bags did not come as shown in the picture with separate compartments for eggs and bottles and no strap latch as advertised.

product_metadata.title: Lotus Trolley Bags -set of 4 -w/LRG COOLER Bag & Egg/Wine holder! Reusable Grocery Cart Bags sized for USA. Eco-friendly 4-Bag Grocery Tote. (Purple, Turquoise, Blue, Brown,)
features: HEAVY-DUTY, HIGH CAPACITY - Simply Better Reusable Grocery Bags. Unlike others, our patented grocery tote design is made with premium high-quality 120 gsm fabric and is double-stitched on the seams and handles to last longer and weight-tested to hold over 60 pounds in each bag! Designed to fit all average-sized shopping carts in U.S. grocery stores including Kroger, Target, Publix, Walmart & Whole Foods. *NOT MEANT FOR COSTCO/SAMS/HEB & ALDI.* Please see our “Club Cart Version” for those stores.

EASY, EFFICIENT SHOPPING - Our grocery cart organizer known as trolley bags streamline your entire shopping experience. Our reusable bags connect in the cart to give you full access and high-visibility as you shop and faster check-out times. They stand tall & upright for easier unloading once home. And, they fold up as one to fit compactly in the back of a shopping cart or car.

MACHINE WASHABLE, LRG COOLER + SMART POCKETS - Each trolley bag grocery cart set includes an insulated grocery bag, a bag with pockets for egg cartons and wine/liquor bottle pockets, and mesh bottomed bags to ensure spills don't pool in the bottom of the bag. Remove the rods to machine wash your new grocery shopping totes and hang them to dry.

VERSATILE USE - These reusable grocery bags feature reinforced straps and long handles to enable comfortable over-the shoulder carry and can be used individually for all kinds of shopping and other activities; simply take out the rods and take the cooler bag to the meat market or the egg bag to the farmers’ market! Or load up the mesh-bottomed bag for a picnic, road trip or to the beach. Don’t settle for knockoffs that don't have our patented removable rod design.

10% OF PROFITS TO CHARITY - At Lotus, 10% of all profits are donated to charity and helps us on our mission to eliminate plastic bags from shopping. This is A GREAT GIFT for anyone who shops for groceries and would appreciate saving time & helping our planet. We gladly offer a 100% Love it or leave it MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE + guarantee they will remain defect free for at least 12 full months of play.
